alexcrichton opened PR #14676 from alexcrichton:less-dropped to bytecodealliance:main:

This fixes an issue with component model futures where DROPPED was spuriously sent in some situations where it was already flagged as done and shouldn't receive any more events.

:thumbs_up: dicej submitted PR review.
alexcrichton added PR #14676 Don't deliver spurious DROPPED events to futures to the merge queue.
:check: alexcrichton merged PR #14676.
alexcrichton removed PR #14676 Don't deliver spurious DROPPED events to futures from the merge queue.
